description: Na₈Ga₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two GaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four GaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-91°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four GaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 92°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.40 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with five NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four GaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 24°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.59 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three GaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-54°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.41 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.63 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.50 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.70 Å. There are two inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to four O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one GaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.91 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to four O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one GaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (1.85 Å) and one longer (1.92 Å) Ga-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ga atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ga octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ga atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ga octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-66°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ga atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ga atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ga octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Ga atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ga atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ga atom.
